scope: Same 18 native raw-directory source, T01 and export slices. No rendering or later stages.
audit: After each successful native attempt, verify original receipt, process exit, ABI correlation, full raw response, source/artifact hashes and gate-specific predicates. Persist observed operands, expected values and PASS/FAIL. Native route independently recalculates the proof before accepting its existing technical audit gate.
fail_closed: Missing, false, unsupported, stale or altered evidence halts before the next slice. Retain failures and mark remaining operations NOT_RUN. No retries, resume, input substitution, synthetic observations or acceptance promotion.
custody: Immutable machine proofs are included in original native audit checkpoints. Native wire token PASS_SLICE_OBSERVATION_AUDIT is retained for compatibility; its note links an explicit machine proof, never an agent observation. Final report distinguishes 18 machine audits and zero human/agent observations.
invariants: Raw inputs and excluded companions byte-identical; frozen C01/C02/C03, shared clearance and T02-T05 unchanged. All original native verification and corruption controls remain. Machine predicates do not change growth geometry, file-grid rules or numerical acceptance bands.
setup: Native project Python, existing macOS file adapter and runner/contracts, owned by one Terminal command. No pre-opened launcher, agent, MCP, network, installation or global settings. Explicit raw directory mandatory; shared job lock prevents concurrency.
rendering: NOT_REQUESTED; no renderer capability, calls or native board images
